description: This file defines an interface IBlockPoolMonitor for monitoring block pool metrics and a class ObjectPoolMonitorBridge that implements IObjectPoolMonitor to bridge object pool metrics with block pool metrics, specifically in the context of memory size management for caching in Orleans.

classes.name: ObjectPoolMonitorBridge
classes.description: Implements IObjectPoolMonitor to bridge object pool metrics to a block pool monitor, translating object counts into memory size metrics based on block size.

methods.name: TrackObjectAllocated
methods.description: Records the allocation of a new object (block), notifying the block pool monitor of increased memory usage.

methods.name: TrackObjectReleased
methods.description: Records the release of an object (block), notifying the block pool monitor of decreased memory usage.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Reports the current object counts (total, available, claimed) by converting them into memory metrics and forwarding to the block pool monitor.
